effect_description_eng:
When this card would be used, if your opponent has 10 or more cards in their trash, reduce the use cost by 3.
[Main] Delete 1 of your opponent's level 6 or lower Digimon. Then, by deleting 1 of your [Evil] or [Fallen Angel] trait Digimon, you may play 1 [Creepymon] from your trash without paying the cost. The Digimon this effect played gains ＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.) and ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) until your opponent's turn ends.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Activate this card's [Main] effects.
